spanish: Y vinieron los pastores y las echaron, y se levantó Moisés y las salvó, y abrevó su rebaño.

findings.issue: Object of וַיְגָרְשׁוּם is Sp3mp; Spanish las marks the driven-out party as feminine plural
צֹאנָם has Sp3mp (their flock); with Moisés as subject, su rebaño can read as his flock rather than their flock

notes: las salvó matches Sp3fp on וַיּוֹשִׁעָן; only the first object gender and the possessive clarity are at issue.
